445: ...He need not destroy:  In any case, it is proper to not give away all of one's hametz to a non-Jew and to fulfill the mitzvah of "destroy" during the sixth hour with the crumbs that he left in order to burn them, for it is as if these crumbs have already been destroyed and even if he leaves them [and does not destroy them] they would not be sufficient to transgress [the prohibition of] "do not see [any hametz in your domain]." Rather, he should leave at least an olive's bulk of hametz in order to fulfill the mitzvah of "destroy" in its proper fashion.
